text:
ashok: quick heads-up — planning a Terraform change to create interface VPC endpoints for secretsmanager + ssm in prod VPCs across accounts. Also adding a PrivateLink (interface endpoint) for our metrics-ingest service in infra-account that will need acceptance. Need guidance on import workflow and a safe canary pattern.

jordan: do we need manual acceptance for the metrics-ingest service? for AWS-managed services like secretsmanager/ssm acceptance is automatic, but our internal service will require AcceptVpcEndpointConnections.

ashok: correct — aws-managed are auto-accepted. metrics-ingest is our endpoint service (infra-account) so infra will have to accept connections. plan to add both to the new module `module.vpc_endpoint_interface`.

maria: ops notes: 1) set `private_dns_enabled = true` for secretsmanager/ssm endpoints so clients hit the AWS managed hostnames transparently. 2) ensure k8s worker SGs allow outbound to endpoint ENIs — we hit a weird failure last year when ENI egress was blocked. :warning:

devex: can you add an import snippet to the PR template? e.g. `terraform import module.vpc.module.vpc_endpoint.aws_vpc_endpoint.secretsmanager["prod"] vpce-0abc12345` and a short checklist for state locking/remote backend.

ashok: adding an example import in the PR — here: 
```bash
# import example (replace ids)
terraform import 'module.vpc.module.vpc_endpoint.aws_vpc_endpoint.secretsmanager["prod"]' vpce-0a1b2c3d
```

jordan: also need to ensure infra-account has the IAM permission to call `ec2:AcceptVpcEndpointConnections` for metrics-ingest. Who owns that infra-account role?

sre-oncall: oncall note — watch interface endpoint ENI quota per AZ. If we create endpoints across many prod VPCs in same AZ you can easily exhaust ENI limits. Add a smoke test: DNS resolution + secretsmanager:GetSecretValue from a canary pod post-apply.

ashok: will implement a smoke k8s job and expose a canary var `create_canary=true` in TF to limit initial rollout to one AZ and a single account. Rollout plan: 1) Create metrics-ingest endpoint in infra-account (accept connections) 2) enable secretsmanager/ssm endpoints with private DNS in one prod VPC as canary 3) run smoke job and roll out more VPCs.

maria: :thumbsup:

jen: security note — ensure CloudTrail logs `AcceptVpcEndpointConnections` and we capture the principal that accepted. Also verify KMS key policy permits use from VPC endpoints if secrets are KMS-protected.

deploy-bot: CI started for branch `ashok/privatelink-endpoints` — terraform plan succeeded with 4 additions, 0 changes, 0 deletions. (link: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/1234)

ashok: PR opened https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/3422 — tagging @maria @jordan @jen for review. planning a deploy window Fri 14:00 PT if no objections.

maria: left a small nit on variable naming in the PR comments.

jordan: I'll take ownership of the CloudFormation/Resolver rule check so the Route53 inbound resolver rules propagate across accounts.

ashok: thanks — will address comments and re-run CI. (reaction :eyes: from jen)
